name: B10-0277/2025 – § 3 – Am 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 3. Stresses the inefficiency of the Electricity Market Design in lowering energy prices and acknowledges its major negative impact on key industrial sectors; highlights the continuation of its failed approach in the proposed plan for affordable energy; calls for a structural transformation of the European energy system based on public and democratic control over production and distribution, and the development of public and green infrastructure as the foundation for any coordinated and well-planned European industrial strategy;
